verdicts.reason: A breaks the step list apart: steps 2–4 are pushed against the left edge in tiny, unreadable text, and step 1 sits alone under the headline. That puts the list out of reading order, leaves big empty gaps on the left and makes the CTA look small and squeezed. B keeps the headline, logo, CTA and jar strong and the steps run 1→4 top to bottom, but step 1 is huge while steps 2–4 are tiny. The step 2–4 rows are also scattered on misaligned left edges (step 2 indented, step 4 offset), so the list has no grid and its fine text is near illegible.
